# Eject vendors exactly the reached logos/* toolchain packages: a
# module importing logos/ascii only gets ascii (plus the fixed
# rt/arena/sync support set) and nothing else, and the ejected tree
# builds under plain go.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

go run .
stdout '^true true$'
cp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt

logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/region.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/ascii/ascii.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/arena/arena.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/enum
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/proc
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/leak
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/io
grep 'gosuda/loGos/rt/ascii' out/main.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/gorun.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/asciiclosure

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ascii"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ascii.EqualFold("Hello", "hello"), ascii.HasPrefixFold("Hello, world", "hello"))
}
